name: Community — MiniMax H3 Emotion TTS Lip-Sync
author: T8mars + IndexTeam + larryvrh
description:
Type the line, pick the mood, get the character saying it. IndexTTS 2.5 speaks your quoted dialogue in the voice you supply, with the emotion you name, and MiniMax H3 lip-syncs the reference character to that speech in one generation.

HOW TO USE IT
1. AUDIO SLOT = a VOICE SAMPLE, 3-10 s of clean speech from the voice you want. It is cloned, not lip-synced. Any language sample works; the spoken line is English.
2. REFERENCE IMAGES = the character(s), up to nine, exactly like the Lip-Sync preset.
3. PROMPT = a normal H3 shot description that contains the line in double quotes. The first "quoted" run of text is what gets spoken, e.g.: A woman in a leather jacket at a microphone, hard blue key light, looks into the camera and says "You are leaving tomorrow, and nobody told me." Static shot.
4. EMOTION (optional) = an [emotion: ...] tag anywhere in the prompt, in plain words: [emotion: angry, clipped], [emotion: sad and tired], [emotion: bright and happy]. The tag is removed from the prompt before H3 sees it. Without a tag the emotion is copied from the voice sample.

The preset prepends the <Audio 1>: fully_copy binding to your prompt automatically. That line is what makes H3 reproduce the speech instead of keeping only the timbre and inventing its own words - three runs without it did exactly that. Do not write your own <Audio 1> line.

Verified 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti (SimpliGen 1.58.2 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, weights hand-placed) and again 2026-09-09 on SimpliGen 1.59.2 with the weights fresh-downloaded by the app: a 6 s angry line at 864x480 with one reference image took 191 s end to end through the agent API (307 s on the cold 1.59.2 run with the TTS weights loading from disk for the first time), and the output transcribes word-perfect against the written line, with the mouth on the words and the emotion in the delivery.

WHAT TO EXPECT. The spoken line is trimmed to the shot length. A line LONGER than the duration is fine - H3 compresses the delivery and keeps all of it (a 55 word line in a 13 s shot came back complete). A line SHORTER than the duration is the one to watch: IndexTTS speaks at roughly five words a second, so a single sentence is about six seconds, and H3 has to generate audio for the whole shot. It fills the leftover gap by repeating and mangling your line, so you get extra words you never wrote. Measured 2026-09-12 at 13 s on two different seeds. KEEP THE DURATION CLOSE TO THE LENGTH OF YOUR LINE - about two seconds per five words - or use the Fit to Shot card in this pack, which paces the line to fill the shot so there is no gap to invent into. Duration default 6 s. Keep lines to one or two sentences per shot. IndexTTS takes 3-5 s per line plus a one-time model load; the H3 part is the Lip-Sync preset's Turbo chain, 6 steps.

DEPENDENCIES, READ BEFORE INSTALLING. Adds the comfyui-indextts25-T8 custom node (pinned) and 7.7 GB of IndexTTS 2.5 weights into the engine's models/TTS folder. The node pins transformers below 5 and its install DOWNGRADES the engine's transformers (5.15.1 -> 4.57.x). SimpliGen's maintainer has confirmed this is allowed and sticks across engine updates; every other shipped pack has been re-verified against it, but any future pack that pins transformers 5 will conflict with this one in the shared engine. If a later IndexTTS node starts on the first run but cannot find its weights, restart SimpliGen once: the models/TTS folder is registered at engine start. REQUIRES SimpliGen 1.59.2 OR NEWER. IndexTTS 2.5 keeps its weights in folders with a dot in the name, and app versions before 1.59.2 refused to download into those, so the install silently skipped all 26 files. 1.59.2 fixed that rule; verified 2026-09-09 with the weights removed first: the app downloaded all 26 files (7.7 GB) into models/TTS/IndexTTS-2.5 on its own, the engine loaded them from there after one restart, and a 6 s line rendered word-perfect through the agent API. If your app is older, update it before installing this pack.

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
extensions.description: Turbo LoRA loader node + dual-schedule sampler node (required - the workflow will fail to load without it)

extensions.name: comfyui-indextts25-T8
extensions.description: IndexTTS 2.5 text-to-speech nodes (T8mars). Its requirements.txt pins transformers<5 and WILL downgrade the engine's transformers on install; the SimpliGen maintainer confirmed such pins are allowed and persist.

requirements.notes: Everything the Lip-Sync preset needs plus the IndexTTS 2.5 weights (7.7 GB, 26 files into models/TTS/IndexTTS-2.5, from t8star's Comfy mirror at a pinned revision) and the comfyui-indextts25-T8 node. The node downgrades the engine's transformers to the 4.5x line; confirmed allowed and persistent by SimpliGen's maintainer (2026-09-02). Verified 2026-09-02 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti (SimpliGen 1.58.2 / engine ComfyUI 0.34.2, weights hand-placed) and again 2026-09-09 on SimpliGen 1.59.2 with the weights fresh-downloaded by the app: a 6 s angry line at 864x480 with one reference image took 191 s end to end through the agent API (307 s on the cold 1.59.2 run with the TTS weights loading from disk for the first time), and the output transcribes word-perfect against the written line, with the mouth on the words and the emotion in the delivery. Emotion vector, text and reference-audio modes were all verified in a vanilla ComfyUI test the same day; this preset uses text mode when an [emotion] tag is present and speaker mode (emotion taken from the voice sample) otherwise. IndexTTS-2.5 model licence: IndexTeam, see the DISCLAIMER in the model repo; the node sets accept_model_license for you.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 TTS Lip-Sync (Fit to Shot)
presets.description:
The same thing as MiniMax H3 Emotion TTS Lip-Sync, with one difference: the spoken line is PACED to fill the shot, so H3 is never left with dead air.

WHY THIS EXISTS. IndexTTS speaks your line at its natural rate - roughly five words a second - and on the standard card whatever is left of the shot is padded with silence. H3 then has to generate audio for the WHOLE shot, and it fills that gap by repeating and mangling your line: you get extra words that you never wrote. A one-sentence line in a 13 second shot is about six seconds of speech and eight seconds of gap, and it garbles reliably - measured on two different seeds. This card tells IndexTTS the duration up front (target_duration_mode = natural) so it re-generates the line at a fitted rate that fills the shot, leaving no gap to invent into.

USE IT WHENEVER YOUR LINE IS SHORTER THAN THE DURATION, which is most of the time - one or two sentences against anything above about 8 seconds. That is the case the standard card gets wrong.

It also works the other way, pacing a slightly over-long line so it fits, but you need this less than you would think: H3 already compresses a too-long line and keeps all of it. A 55 word line in a 13 second shot came back complete and clean on the standard card.

LIMITS. The fitted rate is clamped to 0.5x-2.0x and the node's author recommends 0.8x-1.25x, so a line within about a quarter of the shot length either way sounds natural; past that it starts to sound rushed or drawn out. Shorten or lengthen the line rather than leaning on the fitter. Fitting costs a SECOND TTS inference pass whenever the needed rate differs from 1.0 by more than 0.02, so expect roughly double the IndexTTS time; the H3 video pass is unchanged. Everything else - the voice sample in the audio slot, the quoted line, the [emotion: ...] tag, reference images, the automatic <Audio 1> binding - works exactly as on the standard card; see its description for the full instructions.

VERIFIED 2026-09-12 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti at 13 s / 576x416 / 6 steps: three lines of 29, 39 and 55 words all came back complete and intelligible, speech filling 88-93% of the shot. The same 29 word line on the standard card produced extra invented words on two different seeds. Long durations are demanding on a 12 GB card - the TTS model stays resident while H3 stages, so a 13 s shot can run out of VRAM; close other GPU applications, or drop the duration.
presets.tagline: Paces the line to fill the shot, so H3 cannot invent extra words in the gap
